Name: Zedekiah, Son of Chenaanah
Summary: Zedekiah, son of Chenaanah, made horns of iron and promised Ahab victory at Ramoth-gilead, then smote Micaiah on the cheek when Micaiah foretold disaster.
KeyStory: Zedekiah's iron horns and his blow against Micaiah.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Micaiah, Son of Imlah; Chenaanah, Father of Zedekiah the Prophet; Micaiah, Son of Imla
LifeLesson: A confident lie with iron horns is still a lie; flattery is not prophecy.
